name: Tsubaki Amane
source:
Likes: Drinking, Moegi & Itsuki
Dislikes: Smoking

[url=/c36688]Moegi's[/url] older sister who also treats Itsuki as her younger brother. She is very skilled at household chores and is almost like a master chef, but unfortunately she also loves drinking over everything. Though Amane is very attached to the opposite sex, she's never been in a relationship. She is also currently studying to become a teacher.
